title: Morning Rundown: a test episode
summary: A short test of the rundown pipeline: weather, one story, and a goodbye.

segments.title: Weather
segments.text: Good morning. It's Saturday the eighth of November. In Stuttgart it's four degrees and foggy, clearing to a high of nine this afternoon, with a small chance of rain.

segments.title: News
segments.text: One story this morning. The open-source agent pi has moved to a new home on npm, under the earendil works name. Old installs keep working, but new extensions should import from the new package.

segments.title: Close
segments.text: That's all for today. Have a good weekend.
